extDesc.message: Shows only today's tasks on every new tab, helping you focus on one thing now.

onboardingGuide.message: Start by adding just one thing for today.

emptyStateDescription.message: Write a short task for today, and this tab becomes a simple checklist.

emptyStateExample.message: Not sure what to write? Start small, like "Tidy for 10 minutes."

emptyStateStepInput.message: Type one thing that comes to mind right now.

emptyStateStepReturn.message: Once added, it appears whenever you open a new tab.

emptyTasks.message: No tasks yet. Add one thing to do today.

allTasksComplete.message: Everything for today is complete. Nice work.

taskKeyboardHelp.message: Use Tab to reach task controls. Use Up/Down to move between tasks and Left/Right to move between controls for the same task.
